summary: IAMGOLD filed a Form 6-K containing its Q1 2026 management discussion and analysis and financial statements, along with CEO and CFO certifications. The filing reports quarterly operational and financial results: attributable gold production of 183,600 ounces, revenues of $1,030.1 million from sales of 211,500 ounces at an average realized price of $4,859/oz, cost of sales of $1,619/oz, and AISC of $2,124/oz. Net earnings were $379.7 million. The filing also discusses the share buyback program. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No transaction or corporate action triggering a special-situation classification is present. What to watch: ongoing operational performance and gold price trends.
